products.name: Kimi
products.note: Long-context reasoning; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Moonshot AI's stated mission to optimize "energy to intelligence conversion" signals that the company views compute efficiency, not just raw scale, as central to long-context reasoning models.

Kimi's one-million-token context window and 2.8 trillion parameters position it for knowledge work and deep reasoning tasks where sustained compute over longer sequences matters more than peak throughput. The emphasis on energy efficiency in the founding thesis suggests the company is optimizing for the grid constraint that limits AI scaling. This differs from the pure parameter race and points toward a specific architectural choice: very long context depth requires either exceptional power efficiency or acceptance of higher per-token costs.

The data does not cover Moonshot AI's training infrastructure, power consumption, data center footprint, or funding sources. It does not show whether the energy-to-intelligence framing translates into measurable efficiency gains relative to comparable models, or whether long-context capability actually requires the efficiency gains the mission implies. Cross-border data review requirements for Kimi users suggest regulatory or jurisdictional constraints on deployment, which may limit how the product scales.

profile_text.body:
Moonshot AI, founded in 2023 and based in Beijing, describes its mission as seeking "the optimal conversion from energy to intelligence." The company positions itself as working on what it calls "the new frontier of intelligence."

The company's main AI product is Kimi, a large language model in the chat and general LLMs category. According to the company's description, Kimi features 2.8T parameters, is natively multimodal, and supports a 1M-token context window. The company states it is built for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning. Users reviewing cross-border data should note relevant data considerations.
